title: Find B2B Leads by Job Title, Company and Keyword
summary: How go-to-market teams and their coding agents pull B2B leads by job title, seniority, company size, industry, location and keyword with Cargo: Sales Navigator search with no LinkedIn seat required, or AI Ark when cost matters most. Commands, filter IDs, returned fields and prices.
body_markdown:
**To find B2B leads for a go-to-market list by job title, company and keyword, run Cargo’s` salesNavigator.searchLeads` action with your title keywords, seniority, company size, industry and location filters. It returns each lead’s name, current title, company and LinkedIn URL at 0.2 credits per lead, and you do not need your own Sales Navigator seat.**


For the lowest price per lead,` aiArk.searchPeople` runs the same kind of search at 0.05 credits per person returned. Both are the[find-b2b-leads](https://www.getcargo.ai/skills/find-b2b-leads) job; this page is the full command reference.


## Usage and prices#


Cargo platform data, 90 days to Oct 16 2026:` salesNavigator.searchLeads` ran about 908,000 times across 139 workspaces.


What each source costs, from each action’s credit definition:


Action Credits Charged on Account needed


` salesNavigator.searchLeads` 0.2 each lead returned none (optional: your own LinkedIn)


` aiArk.searchPeople` 0.05 each person returned none (optional: your AI Ark key)


` apolloio.searchPeople` 0, or 1 with` shouldEnrich` each person, when enriching none (optional: your Apollo key)


A search that returns nobody costs 0 credits. A new account starts with 100 free credits and no card, which covers 500 Sales Navigator leads or 2,000 from AI Ark.


## What the Sales Navigator search needs#


No Sales Navigator subscription and no LinkedIn login. By default the search runs on a shared pool of LinkedIn identities that Cargo operates, metered by a daily per-workspace quota on a rolling 24-hour window. If you want it to run on your own seat instead, sync your LinkedIn session with the Cargo Chrome extension and pass that user in` identityIds` ; the run then spends that seat’s allowance and not the pool’s.


## Run it#


### 1. Install and sign in


shellscript


```text
npm   install   -g   @cargo-ai/cli
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com                   # sends a code
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com   --code   123456     # creates the account on first use


```


There is no browser step, so a coding agent can run this itself.


### 2. Search


VPs and directors with “Sales” in their current title, at software companies of 51 to 500 people, located in the United States:


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"salesNavigator","actionSlug":"searchLeads"}'   \
--data   '{
"role": {"titleKeywords": ["Sales"], "seniorityLevels": ["300", "220"]},
"company": {"companyHeadcounts": ["D", "E"]},
"personal": {"geoCodes": ["103644278"], "industryCodes": ["4"]},
"limit": 25
}'   \
--wait-until-finished


```


` keywords` adds a free-text search across the whole profile, for a word that is not in the title (a tool, a market, a technology).` limit` defaults to 25 and goes up to 10,000. Start at 25: that is one page, 5 credits, and enough to check the filters do what you meant before paying for the rest.


### 3. Filters take LinkedIn IDs, not names


Seniority, headcount, location, industry and function are LinkedIn’s codes. A name in their place is not translated. The common ones:


Filter Value


` role.seniorityLevels`` 310` CXO,` 300` Vice President,` 220` Director,` 210` Experienced Manager


` company.companyHeadcounts`` C` 11-50,` D` 51-200,` E` 201-500,` F` 501-1,000,` G` 1,001-5,000


` personal.geoCodes`` 103644278` United States


` personal.industryCodes`` 4` Software Development


` role.functions`` 25` Sales


For the full lists, run the connector’s autocomplete with the` listGeoCodes` ,` listIndustries` ,` listSeniorityLevels` ,` listCompanyHeadcounts` or` listFunctions` slug. The connector UUID is in the` connectors` field of` cargo-ai orchestration action list search leads --integration-slug salesNavigator` :


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   connection   connector   autocomplete   \
--connector-uuid   <  uui  d  >   --slug   listGeoCodes   --params   '{}'


```


Most filters also have an` ...Exclude` twin (` titleKeywordsExclude` ,` geoCodesExclude` ,` currentCompanyIdsExclude` ) to remove matches, and` recentUpdates.changedJobs` keeps only people who recently changed jobs.


### 4. The same search on AI Ark


AI Ark filters take plain values instead of IDs:


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"aiArk","actionSlug":"searchPeople"}'   \
--data   '{
"jobRole": {"title_or": ["VP Sales", "Director of Sales"], "seniority_or": ["vp", "director"]},
"industry": {"industry_or": ["software development"]},
"employeeSize": {"min_employee_count": 51, "max_employee_count": 500},
"personLocation": {"location_or": ["United States"]},
"limit": 25
}'   \
--wait-until-finished


```


` personKeywords.keyword_or` is the free-text keyword filter, matched on headline and summary by default. Seniority and industry values must come from AI Ark’s lists (lowercase, such as` c_suite` ,` vp` ,` director` ,` head` ); a value outside them fails validation.` limit` defaults to 10 and goes up to 2,000.


## What comes back#


Action Fields to read


` salesNavigator.searchLeads`` full_name` ,` job_title` ,` company_name` ,` location` ,` linkedin_profile_url` ,` sales_navigator_profile_url` ,` tenure_start` ,` recently_hired`


` aiArk.searchPeople`` full_name` ,` title` ,` headline` ,` linkedin_url` ,` company_name` ,` company_domain` ,` country` ,` city`


` apolloio.searchPeople`` first_name` ,` last_name_obfuscated` ,` title` ,` has_email` ,` organization.name` , unless` shouldEnrich` is on


Apollo’s search is free but partial by design: the last name is obfuscated and there is no LinkedIn URL until you enrich, at 1 credit per person.


None of these return emails or phone numbers. Pass the LinkedIn URLs to[enrich a LinkedIn profile](https://www.getcargo.ai/skills/enrich-linkedin-profile) , or names and domains to the[work email waterfall](https://www.getcargo.ai/blog/find-and-verify-work-emails-at-scale) .


## Caveats#


- **Over 2,500 results.** LinkedIn caps a single Sales Navigator search at 2,500 results. Above that, Cargo splits the search into narrower sub-searches and walks them, so a large` limit` still returns distinct leads, but the count can come in under it.
- **No duplicates within a run.** Leads already returned earlier in the same run are dropped from later pages.
- **Profiles, not consent.** A search result is a person who matches your filters. Whether you may contact them depends on your basis for doing so and your suppression list, not on the search.


## Frequently asked questions#
